Rank the twelve largest absolute differences between the RNA and protein log2 ratios. Give their Ensembl IDs, symbols, four measurements, both ratios, secretome location and main subcellular locations. Draw an RNA-versus-protein fold-change scatter, a direction-count bar chart and a heatmap of those twelve genes' two fold changes; provide the plotted data. Break ranking ties by Ensembl ID. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

pk AS (

    WHERE Tissue = 'kidney'
),
pc AS (
    SELECT Gene, TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE) as prot_c
    FROM ms_tissue
    WHERE Tissue = 'colon'
),
retained AS (
    SELECT 
        dt.Ensembl,
        dt.Gene,
        log2(rk.rna_k / rc.rna_c) as log2_rna,
        log2(pk.prot_k / pc.prot_c) as log2_prot
    FROM dt
    JOIN rk ON dt.Ensembl = rk.Gene
    JOIN rc ON dt.Ensembl = rc.Gene
    JOIN pk ON dt.Ensembl = pk.Gene
    JOIN pc ON dt.Ensembl = pc.Gene
    WHERE rk.rna_k > 0 AND rc.rna_c > 0 AND pk.prot_k > 0 AND pc.prot_c > 0
),
ranked_rna AS (
    SELECT 
        log2_rna,
        (MIN(rn) + MAX(rn)) / 2.0 as rna_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT log2_rna, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY log2_rna) as rn
        FROM retained
    )
    GROUP BY log2_rna
),

        log2_prot,
